WHATSAPP ASSISTANT (chat to order)
Same brain as the website. Customers message your WhatsApp Business number: ask prices, add products, check delivery, place a cash-on-delivery order, request a callback or report a problem. Their number is used automatically (no phone question). Unknown questions go to the AI agent (workflow 01) when ai_fallback is yes.
Setup: Meta developer app, WhatsApp Cloud API, webhook URL = this workflow's /webhook/vaigai-whatsapp, verify token = wa_verify_token, subscribe to 'messages'. Messages are verified with your app secret (wa_app_secret). Create a 'WA Sessions' tab from sheets/WA Sessions.csv. Replies inside 24 hours need no template.
Set the values in the Config node (webhook key, Google Sheet ID, WhatsApp and Telegram details). The website sends the same key in the x-vaigai-key header. Credentials: Google Sheets OAuth2, Telegram, OpenAI (assistant only). Nodes marked optional are disabled until you add credentials.
